Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: pale green and grey." titles.title: Grey Tree, Lake George

credit_line: Alfred Stieglitz Collection, Bequest of Georgia O'Keeffe, 1986
description: A dynamic, abstract tree occupies the center of the composition, running from the bottom to the top of the canvas. The tree's gray branches and trunk seem to emit wisps of smoke, interacting with the abstracted gray, green, and brown forms in the background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
